recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to GuidanceResponse should proceed through current CDS/CQI work rather than reopening the STU3 deprecation reversal; no follow-up core source edit is recommended for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14179 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking that GuidanceResponse not be deprecated because implementers needed it for persistent decision-support request/response records, DataRequirement prompts, RequestGroup/request orchestration results, CDS Hooks-related response recording, and profile/extension-based implementation guidance. The resolution was to reverse deprecation and continue evolving GuidanceResponse with CDS Hooks and Clinical Quality Improvement input.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in git-svn commit 43553fde72d177e29e7f8406bb14a3eaf6c4af77, matching the Jira comment SVN 13324. That commit expanded GuidanceResponse scope/use-case documentation and added purpose text, retaining the resource rather than marking it deprecated.
additional_context: GuidanceResponse remains in the current build through active fhir.ini entries for the resource, CDS work group, patient security category, FMM 4, and approved status. The current StructureDefinition carries normative/FMM 4 metadata and purpose text for decision-support interaction records, public-health reportability determinations, and additional data requirements. Later commits clarified persistence, added an additional-data example, matured the resource and mappings, and redirected detailed CDS Hooks discussion to the external Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG without reversing the non-deprecated status.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source already satisfies the FHIR-14179 decision: GuidanceResponse is active, documented for the issue's substantive use cases, and has no remaining deprecation wording.

related_jiras.note: Clarified GuidanceResponse persistence use and removed temporary ballot note after the FHIR-14179 application.
Added a GuidanceResponse example for requesting additional data, reinforcing one of the FHIR-14179 use cases.
Matured GuidanceResponse and mapping details, supporting the current non-deprecated/normative state.
Moved detailed CDS Hooks guidance to the external IG while preserving GuidanceResponse's active core role and IG reference.
